title: Recording: Beware My Love by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

Wings worked on the Wings At The Speed Of Sound song ‘Beware My Love’ on 22 January 1976.

They had recorded an early version of the song on 28 August 1975, and reworked it on 17 October.

This session was primarily a rehearsal, although the results were recorded. Wings performed 14 takes of the song, featuring Paul McCartney and Jimmy McCulloch on acoustic guitars, Denny Laine on bass guitar, and Joe English on drums.
